source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Integrated QRS frontal direction within -45 to -90 degrees.

authored_choices.projection: derive RA/LA/LL from I/II in zero-sum gauge; preserve reference chest QRS relative to Wilson; P/T retained

constraints: aVL R peak at least45ms; QRS100ms below120ms
limitations: Authored fixed vector and timing, not calibrated anatomical conduction or automated diagnosis
Optional poor chest R progression, deep lateral S and V1 QS variants not implemented
No inferred perfusion impairment or other rhythm combination
